title: Heterogeneous Price Effects of Consolidation: Evidence from the Car Rental Industry
authors: Ali Umut Guler; Kanishka Misra; Vishal Singh
eligible_reason: Treatment is market structure measured as counts (number of firms, number of independent owners, number of affiliated firms, HHI), not a binary staggered indicator. Regressions of log rental price on these counts with airport x vendor FE, vendor x pickup-date and car-type x pickup-date interactions across three cross-sections (2005, 2009, 2016). The appendix merger-effect regression (Table A6) also uses a count (merg_eff = simulated minus actual owners).
design_notes: stata_do_file.do: xi: areg ln_price i.vendor*i.pickup i.cartype*i.pickup monthly n_owners n_affifirms, absorb(aidf) cluster(aidf), if weekend==0/1 (Table 3, Figure 6-7); aidf = group(airport vendor). Appendix Tables A2-A6 vary samples, add airport-year FE, HHI and merger-effect counts.
data_files_note: Single analysis file (54,024 rows; airports x vendors x car types x 3 collection years) shipped; no README.
data_provenance_note: Scraped price data shipped as analysis file; no statement of sampling or disguise.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally; screened from code, data and abstract. Regression inventory was empty (CRLF do-file); read the do-file directly.
